summary: Python-centric enterprise development with agent-based architecture, schema-driven validation, and containerized deployment patterns.

rules.rule: Agent modules follow snake_case naming with descriptive role-based names (analyst, architect, developer, etc.)
JSON schema validation enforced through .deliveryos/schemas/ directory with versioned schema files
Standard library imports first, followed by third-party, then local imports with clear separation
Docker containerization with docker-compose for multi-service orchestration
Centralized configuration through config.py module with environment-based settings

lint_recommendations: Implement consistent docstring standards across agent modules
Add type hints for better code maintainability
Standardize error handling patterns across components
scaffold_templates: Agent module template with base class inheritance
FastAPI route module template with schema validation
Docker service template for new components
JSON schema template for API contracts
